messages:
Ana (ML): heads up — after merging the AWQ act-quant change (actq=3) into canary for model-mosaic-4b we started seeing transient correctness drops + big tail latency on gpu-pool-3.
Shay: what symptoms exactly? errors or perplexity drift?
Ana (ML): short answers: small increase in top-1/accuracy delta on hellaswag (~2.8%), and some serving threads hit 500s while median stayed fine. traces show repeated model re-inits.
Peter R: any patterns across requests? long context vs short?
Ana (ML): mostly long-context (>1024) chat-like requests that use KV cache and prefix caching. repro locally with the same prompt set within the serving harness.
Jasmin: can you paste the config used in canary?
Ana (ML): config snippet:
```
model: mosaic-4b-awq
quant: AWQ
group_size: 128
act_quant: 3
kv_cache: enabled
batching: auto
```
Shay: group_size 128 feels high with act_quant enabled — we saw numeric instabilities before for >64 in sim runs.
Peter R: infra-bot shows canary deploy -> degraded 2023-11-02 09:12:03 UTC, rollback not yet triggered.
infra-bot: Canary health check: 56% p95 latency regression on gpu-pool-3, error rate +0.6% over baseline, flagged by SLA monitor.
Ana (ML): repro logs show occasional NaN in logits before softmax, followed by abort/rei nits. suspect act-quant interaction with attention kernel when group_size crosses 64 boundary.
Jasmin: did we try act_quant=2 or lowering group_size?
Ana (ML): quick local sweep: act_quant=2 + group_size=64 -> no NaNs, p95 back to baseline. act_quant=3 + group_size=64 -> intermittent but much rarer. act_quant=3 + group_size=32 -> stable.
Shay: sounds like a stability cliff: act_quant aggressiveness amplifies accumulation error with larger groups. We should rollback canary and run focused sweep.
Peter R: I'm going to kick rollback now and open a follow-up run. DeployBot: can you schedule a deduped job that sweeps [group_size: 16,32,64,96,128] x [act_quant: 1,2,3] on gpu-staging with the full kv-cache workload? tag as awq-actq-sweep-176245.
DeployBot: Job awq-actq-sweep-176245 queued on gpu-staging, ETA ~40m.
Jasmin: also include a tiny-run with FP8/GPTQ baseline for comparison so we see relative accuracy vs AWQ modes.
Ana (ML): logging checklist for sweep: enable per-request debug for failed inits, dump raw logits for first 8 tokens, and capture kernel launch params. I'll add the eval harness prompts.
Shay: after rollback we should pin model to AWQ act_quant=2 for canary until sweep completes.
Peter R: agreed. rolling back now and patching canary config.
infra-bot: Rollback initiated for canary deployment at 2023-11-02 09:28:12 UTC.
Ana (ML): thanks — once sweep lands i'll analyze accuracy deltas and propose a safe default acting policy (conservative act_quant + group cap) for serving.
Shay: nice triage. small follow-up: also check GEMM kernel logs for any saturations, and collect GPU SM utilization during failures.
Ana (ML): will do, will post a short summary after the sweep results come in. :hourglass:
